id: title:Gilbert09:convert postgres range and multirange columns to text

review.posthog_relevance: Warehouse ingestion compatibility for Postgres range columns, preventing ingestion failures when warehouse sources expose range types.
review.reason: The change adds psycopg range and multirange support, converts pyarrow columns to strings, and implements JSON serialization compatible with PostHog's warehouse ingestion. P1.F1.H3 demonstrates the implementation of compatibility and tests, while P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 provide supporting imports. This is a substantive, bounded correctness improvement for warehouse ingestion.
review.uncertainty: The tier relies on P1.F1.H3 for the actual implementation and compatibility; P1.F1.H1 and P1.F1.H2 are supporting and do not independently establish the benefit. No unverified outcomes or adoption are inferred.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs detected. No missing context. No abstention.

observations.behavior: Adds `import re` and no other changes.
observations.posthog_connection: No observable PostHog mechanism; the import is not used in this hunk. Its purpose is established only later in P1.F1.H3.

observations.behavior: Adds regex, range formatting, and JSON serialization support for psycopg Range/Multirange; converts pyarrow column to string; adds tests.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds compatibility for Postgres range columns imported into PostHog warehouse ingestion. Without this, pyarrow rejects psycopg Range/Multirange objects, breaking warehouse ingestion for warehouse sources that expose range columns. This hunk also adds the conversion and JSON serialization, and the corresponding tests.
